summary: Repaired /srv/inventory and verified the changes persist across a node1 reboot. Existing file contents remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the missing locked system account inventorysvc and group inventory-readers.
Changed the existing tree ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers.
Set directories to 0750 and files to 0640.
Verified owner and reader-group access, unrelated-user denial, and unchanged file hashes.
Restarted node1 safely and verified full recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Existing data is owned by inventorysvc
evidence.summary: All directories and files report owner inventorysvc and group inventory-readers before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: Existing data is readable by inventory-readers
evidence.summary: An unrelated UID operating only with the inventory-readers GID successfully read and hashed both files.

evidence.requirement: Existing data is inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: Directories are 0750, files are 0640, ACLs grant no other access, and direct unrelated-user read and traversal tests were denied.
SHA-256 hashes for config.json and records.csv match before repair, after repair, and after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 483545cc-8754-4eeb-ab06-ac268b896bab, received the delayed reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 684f6039-a733-456e-a1c1-de8079fb6b06, then confirmed system state running, zero failed units, persistent identities, permissions, access controls, and data hashes.
